name: Jamil Buthayna
bio: A poet of the Banu Udhra tribe who lived in Wadi al-Qura, in the Hijaz, under the Umayyads. He loved Buthayna, a woman of his own tribe, from his youth. Her family refused him and married her to another man, and he spent his life writing poems to her, so that people came to call him by her name. He is the leading voice of Udhri poetry: chaste, devoted love that does not end. The poet Kuthayyir Azza transmitted his poems. He died in Egypt in 82 AH (701 CE).
